$comment: Coverage of the UNIT-testable modules. The tests import tests/.build/*.mjs,
which esbuild produces from src/*.ts (see tests/build-format.mjs), so the
numbers are attributed to the BUILT files rather than to the sources: one
built module is one src module, bundled with nothing but its own siblings,
and the line numbers differ from the .ts only by the type annotations
esbuild stripped. There is no source map in the test build on purpose - it
is thrown away and rebuilt on every run.
'exclude' is deliberately EMPTY: c8's default exclude list drops anything
under tests/, which is exactly where the built modules live, and with the
defaults in place every file came out at 0%.
The thresholds are the level the suite actually reached when they were set
(95.9 lines, 90.77 functions, 86.45 branches), rounded down. They are a
REGRESSION gate, not a target: raise them when the real number rises.
